rows.heading: Learning Outcomes
outcomes: Identify services provided by human service agencies.
Identify and analyze the impact of legislation on the services provided by human services agencies.
Identify and describe the various roles and skills needed by a human service worker.
Communicate perspectives relating to Human Services clearly and in a manner that shows respect and sensitivity to others.

Describe current roles and practices of the human service professional.
Apply knowledge, skill, and understanding for competent performance in human services settings including those related to policy and procedure, state and nationwide.

rows.heading: Learning Outcomes
outcomes: Produce beginning-level American Sign Language communication using fingerspelling, vocabulary, classifiers, and appropriate expressive and receptive body orientation.
Demonstrate effective communication through appropriate use of eye contact, body orientation, facial expression, and grammatical structures in dialogues and storytelling.
Apply culturally appropriate social behaviors in ASL interactions to support respectful and effective communication.
Analyze introductory aspects of Deaf culture and history to explain their influence on language use and community identity.

rows.heading: Learning Outcomes
outcomes: Identify types of measurement and evaluate chemical reactions to solve related quantitative problems by using appropriate nomenclature, stoichiometry and other useful formulas.
Using the periodic table, atomic structure and chemical and physical processes, examine the states of matter, covalent and ionic bonding and intermolecular forces.
Safely perform basic laboratory techniques while observing and recording data to formulate and test hypotheses by applying the scientific method.

rows.heading: Learning Outcomes

Recognize barriers to effective intercultural competencies such as stereotyping, prejudice, and ethnocentrism.
Identify elements of common ground among diverse cultures.

Identify the components of culture and communication and their interrelationship.
Explain how culture influences verbal and nonverbal communication.
Identify and explain the social and psychological variables of culture and its expression
Discuss the diverse ways of thinking, perceptions and interpretations.
Compare and contrast intercultural communication strategies in various contexts
Recognize barriers to effective intercultural competencies such as stereotyping, prejudice, and ethnocentrism
Identify elements of common ground among diverse cultures.

rows.heading: Learning Outcomes
outcomes: Identify and describe major global, regional, and local environmental issues.
Analyze the scientific basis of major environmental issues and identify and evaluate potential solutions.
Use scientific methodologies and explain how the scientific method is used to better understand environmental issues.
Analyze and interpret quantitative data and visual representations of data.
Show relationships between human actions and environmental issues and examine the impacts of environmental issues on human populations.

rows.heading: Learning Outcomes
outcomes: Apply the skills, knowledge, and abilities required in routine and emergency firefighting operations for both structure and wildland.
Explain and demonstrate the skills necessary to perform basic rescue operations including auto extrication, swiftwater, confined space, and first responder.
Demonstrate the proper methods to operate, inspect, and maintain firefighting and rescue equipment.
Explain the methods of executing basic fire prevention and fire investigation tasks.
Track daily individual progress in preparation for performance of all elements of the Physical Efficiency Battery to established standards.
Explain and demonstrate the skills necessary to perform FRA and FRO HazMat operations.
